public.aboutSubtitle: A community-driven initiative providing mutual support for funeral arrangements in Village Noormang since 2018.
public.ourMissionText: To provide timely and dignified funeral assistance to member families, ensuring that no family faces the burden of funeral expenses alone during their time of grief.
public.ourStoryText: Noormang Mutual Committee was established in 2018 by concerned community members who recognized the financial hardship faced by families during bereavement. Through collective contributions, we ensure that every registered member family receives proper funeral assistance and community support.
public.obj1: Provide immediate financial assistance for funeral expenses to member families
public.obj2: Ensure dignified and timely funeral arrangements for all members
public.obj3: Promote community solidarity and mutual support during difficult times
public.obj4: Maintain transparent financial records and accountability to all members
public.obj5: Expand membership to include all deserving families in the community
public.chairmanName: Muhammad Aslam — President, Noormang Mutual Committee
public.chairmanMessageText: Alhamdulillah, our committee has been serving the community for many years. Through collective effort and trust, we have been able to support our brothers and sisters during their most difficult moments. I invite all community members to join this noble cause and strengthen our community bond.

public.faqSubtitle: Find answers to commonly asked questions about membership, funeral assistance, and payments.
public.faq1Q: Who can become a member of the committee?
public.faq1A: Any permanent resident of Village Noormang can request membership. Simply contact the committee secretary or any committee member. The committee will verify your eligibility and add you as a registered member.
public.faq2Q: Is there a membership registration fee?
public.faq2A: There is no fixed registration fee. Once you are registered, whenever a funeral case occurs, the total expenses are divided equally among all active members. The contribution amount varies per case based on the actual expenses incurred.
public.faq3Q: How long does the registration process take?
public.faq3A: Registration is handled directly by the committee admin. After you contact a committee member and request membership, the admin will verify your eligibility and register you, typically within a few working days.
public.faq4Q: What expenses does the committee cover?
public.faq4A: The committee covers all essential funeral expenses including: Kafan (shroud and burial cloth), preparation and washing of the deceased, transportation of the deceased, and grave digging and burial. Additional arrangements may be made at the committee's discretion.
public.faq5Q: How quickly does the committee respond to a funeral case?
public.faq5A: The committee is available at all times for funeral emergencies. Upon notification, the president and secretary are contacted immediately and arrangements are started as soon as possible.
public.faq6Q: What happens if a member cannot attend the Janaza?
public.faq6A: Physical attendance at the Janaza is encouraged but not mandatory. However, the financial contribution is compulsory for all active members regardless of whether they attend.
public.faq7Q: When are contributions collected after a funeral?
public.faq7A: Collection notices are sent to all members after the funeral case expenses are finalized. Members are given a reasonable grace period to submit their contribution through any of the accepted payment methods.
public.faq8Q: What payment methods are accepted for contributions?
public.faq8A: Contributions can be paid by cash directly to the finance secretary, or via bank transfer, Easypaisa, or JazzCash. Account details are available on the Donation page.
